defects: (a) THE SEAT'S: A CUT PLANNER THAT LEFT A LINE OF ONE SPACE. The first plan of the cut (relay data/b655_cut_plan.txt) removed a row dropped as a repeat together with the one space before it, and where the row had stood on its own line after a blank one (#3 BallPairShadow, #13 E2EvenMonotoneShadow) a line holding a single space stayed inside the comment. Caught on the seat's reading of the planned edits, before any kernel byte was written; the planner now takes the whole whitespace run that led to a removed row, or the run after it where the row opens its region (#50), and the plan was re-run and read again before the cut.

(b) THE SEAT'S: A WORKFLOW DRAFT THAT READ WRAPPED PRINTS BY ONE LINE. The first draft of SIDE-global-section's workflow took the Interfaces prints by a single-line grep, which misses a print Lean wraps over lines, and carried an awk line with no effect. Caught on reading the draft, before its commit; the prints are now joined to their closing bracket by a short python reader inside the run, and the dead line is gone.

(c) THE SEAT'S: A POSITIVE CONTROL THAT MUTATED NOTHING. G-KERNEL-NAMED's positive control replaced the text "|   43 |" in the kernels table, whose cell reads "|  43 |", so the mutated copy equalled the live one and the arm passed its own positive control (relay data/b655_checks_mid1.txt: POSITIVE-CONTROL PASSES 1). Caught at the mid-act reading, before the face; the control now mutates SIDE-global-section's own row ("| 1007 |   8 |  43 |", one occurrence), read live True and positive False.
